behavior: The owner can email an invoice to the client's billing email with Send to client, and the invoice page lists each send (PLAN 10.5)
acceptance: POST /v1/profiles/{id}/invoices/{invoiceId}/send queues one outbox email to the invoice's client email when the payer can still pay it (open or partly paid, checkout not closed). A retry with the same Idempotency-Key queues no second one. No client email is 409 client_email_required; a closed invoice is 409 invoice_closed; another user is 403. One send per invoice per 24 h and 20 per profile per day, then 429 rate_limited; sends also count toward the limit for everyone together (R-82).

The worker sends it to the client whatever the owner's email setting: issuer, invoice number, amount, token and due date, with links to the pay page and the invoice PDF, and Reply-To set to the issuer's billing contact email. Tests use the fake sender; no address is logged.

The owner's invoice page has Send to client under Billed to; without a client email it says why instead of sending. Billed to lists each send with the address and the time the worker sent it, or Sending before then. axe 0 and no sideways scroll at 390 px.
openapi.yaml and docs/backend/api.md describe the endpoint, its errors and limits, and the new email.
